# Chapters the security gates enforce (.github/workflows/security-gates.yml).
#
# The guide is being rewritten security-first, Part by Part. Until a chapter
# is rewritten it still fails the gates, and a pull request cannot stay red
# for months. So the gates run in report mode: a chapter that fails is listed
# in the run summary and does not fail the job. A chapter named here is
# different. If it fails any gate, or no gate reports on it, the job fails.
#
# Add a chapter in the pull request that finishes it, so the chapter can
# never regress after that. One path per line, relative to full-guide/. A
# directory enforces everything under it, example trees included.
# Remove a line only if the chapter is deleted or renamed.

00-foundations/
01-core-workloads/01-pods.md
01-core-workloads/
